retrieval.title: RQ1 · What reaches the ranker?
retrieval.context: Validation · Recall@200 · per-user macro · 232,904 events / 124,416 users · exact search
retrieval.note: Baselines use the retriever-training period. Two-tower/recency/mixed rows use the frozen candidate-pool study; learned baselines average three seeds (Popularity and ItemKNN are deterministic). No paired interval is supplied for every displayed pair. Mixing changes candidate membership, not the 200-item budget.

k.title: RQ2 · More candidates, better recommendations?
k.context: Validation · natural-only MLP, arm C · Ktrain=200 · frozen weights · three ranker seeds · per-user macro
k.note: Recall comes from the fixed seed-0 two-tower; ranking quality averages three MLP seeds. Intervals are paired differences versus K=100, not uncertainty bars on each score. K=100 and K=200 are not distinguishable in this comparison; no universal best K is established.

ranker.title: RQ3 · Which ranker orders the same list better?
ranker.context: Test · matching-feature MLP / DIN · K=200 · three seeds · corrected nDCG@10 per-user macro
ranker.note: Compare MLP with DIN inside the selected pool. These are separately trained models, not a frozen-ranker pool swap. DIN also changes candidate/history interactions; this does not isolate attention alone. Mixed-list Test scores now reuse natural-only training normalisation. The correction audit reproduced all twelve saved Validation and historical Test arrays; original results remain separate. These November checkpoints differ from R1’s October frozen rankers.

frozen.title: R1 · Change retrieval with the ranker frozen
frozen.context: Test · 297,390 queries / 112,081 users · October natural-list MLP / DIN · three ranker seeds, one fresh-retriever seed · per-user macro
frozen.note: The fresh retriever trains on A+B before August 2021. The rankers stay trained on B lists from the old A-only retriever. This is a transfer intervention, not a consistently retrained cascade. November 9 was a post-hoc Test follow-up. Fresh-list MLP loss is inconclusive; DIN loses. Mixed lists improve both frozen models. Recall is macro over the full Test cohort, and is supplied only for the all-products rows. The exact K500 recall increase is 82.41%; the original poster prints 83%.

retrain.title: R2 · Let the ranker learn the new lists
retrain.context: Validation · residual BCE text ranker · T0 statistics · K=200 · three seeds · nDCG@10 per-user macro
retrain.note: Original: recency lists, 20,676 natural-positive training lists. Size-matched mixed: 20,676; full mixed: 38,861. Size-matched fits hit the 10-epoch cap. The intervention changes candidate/scoring setup and training exposure; it is not a pure candidate-distribution ablation. The poster’s four-bar panel is Validation, although its shared caption says Test.

final.title: R4 · What happens when we combine the changes?
final.context: Test · residual-ranker family · K=200 · three seeds · nDCG@10 per-user macro · 297,390 events / 112,081 users
final.note: S1→S8 is the matched study’s combined-system contrast. The original planned two-tower+MLP baseline is from the separate RQ3 family; its approximately 2× ratio is descriptive and has no supplied cross-study paired interval. No single improvement causes the whole combined gain. Test was evaluated in multiple studies; it was not globally untouched.

timing.title: R3 · The same model, information of a different age
timing.context: Test · frozen residual BCE text ranker · recency candidates unchanged · T0-trained · three seeds · nDCG@10 per-user macro
timing.note: T0=26 Jul 2020; T1=11 Aug 2021; T2=16 Jul 2022. Period-start scoring at T2 mirrors the training rule that used T0. Lag 0 means the start of the query’s month. Lag controls retain frozen weights; monthly training+scoring is a separate retrained system. Available intervals compare lag arms with lag 0, not every adjacent pair.

ann.title: Appendix · Search is an accuracy–speed trade-off
ann.context: 1,000 fixed Validation queries · residual BCE text ranker · K=200 · measured CPU benchmark · per-user macro
ann.note: Adaptive HNSW preserved measured nDCG in this cohort; IVF lost quality despite retaining about 95% of exact candidates. Overlap is not purchase recall. Latency is end-to-end median for this implementation and cohort, not a production guarantee. Paired intervals unavailable here.
